data_fields.name: xp_growth_ratio_above_table
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.2 times the last step, rounded to 100

data_fields.name: wisdom_cadence_total_levels
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (forced for magic races when total secondary level is a multiple of 3)

best_idea: Make a level-up a pure, replayable function of (world seed, hero id, stats, XP before and after): the offer is a seeded weighted pick with a blacklist, and multi-level XP gains run one level-up per level crossed.
decision_why: The level-up log can be derived from XP and a seed, so the server re-derives every level-up with no second stored record (one ledger); Frankendom needs its own portable hash and PRNG (donor uses std::hash and PCG32) and must check any human pick against the offer the server sent.
acceptance: A server test grants 2500 XP to a level-1 hero in one call and in 100-XP steps (autoselect on, same world seed) and both produce the same ordered level-up log (level, primary stat, offer, pick).
